title: fix(server): redact the API key in the recovery request dumps

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,7 @@
+### PR [#2277](https://github.com/danielmiessler/Fabric/pull/2277) by [pcbeingused333](https://github.com/pcbeingused333) and [ksylvan](https://github.com/ksylvan): fix(server): redact the API key in the recovery request dumps
+
+- Fixed the server so that `gin.Recovery()` request dumps no longer leak the `X-API-Key` header in clear text; `Cookie` and `Proxy-Authorization` are now masked as well.
+- Applied the redaction through the Gin recovery middleware, so both the REST and Ollama servers are protected, with tests covering the debug-mode panic dump and the broken-pipe dump.
+- Exported `RedactingWriter` and simplified the recovery log redaction logic, splitting request dumps on CRLF and matching header prefixes case-sensitively.
+- Fixed flaky CLI image tests by isolating their files in a private temporary directory instead of the shared `/tmp`, preventing "image file already exists" failures during parallel runs.
+- Switched image test paths to automatic `t.TempDir()` cleanup and portable path construction with `filepath.Join`.

@@ -0,0 +1,65 @@
+package restapi
+
+import (
+	"bytes"
+	"net/http"
+	"net/http/httptest"
+	"strings"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/danielmiessler/fabric/internal/core"
+	"github.com/danielmiessler/fabric/internal/plugins/db/fsdb"
+	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
+)
+
+// TestRecoveryDumpsRedactCredentials checks the request dump that gin writes
+// when a handler panics. The debug-mode panic dump and the broken-pipe dump
+// both print the request headers, and the key is in one of them.
+func TestRecoveryDumpsRedactCredentials(t *testing.T) {
+	const (
+		apiKey = "synthetic-api-key-0123456789"
+		cookie = "session=synthetic-cookie-value"
+	)
+
+	cases := []struct {
+		name   string
+		mode   string
+		panics any
+	}{
+		{"debug-mode panic dump", gin.DebugMode, "synthetic panic"},
+		{"broken-pipe dump", gin.ReleaseMode, http.ErrAbortHandler},
+	}
+	for _, tc := range cases {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			t.Setenv("OPENAI_API_KEY", "")
+			oldWriter := gin.DefaultErrorWriter
+			t.Cleanup(func() {
+				gin.DefaultErrorWriter = oldWriter
+				gin.SetMode(gin.TestMode)
+			})
+			var logged bytes.Buffer
+			gin.DefaultErrorWriter = &logged
+
+			registry := &core.PluginRegistry{Db: fsdb.NewDb(t.TempDir())}
+			r := newSecuredEngine(registry, apiKey, nil, "no key")
+			r.GET("/boom", func(c *gin.Context) { panic(tc.panics) })
+			gin.SetMode(tc.mode) // the engine sets release mode; the panic dump needs debug
+
+			req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/boom", nil)
+			req.Header.Set(APIKeyHeader, apiKey)
+			req.Header.Set("Cookie", cookie)
+			req.Header.Set("User-Agent", "synthetic-agent")
+			r.ServeHTTP(httptest.NewRecorder(), req)
+
+			out := logged.String()
+			if !strings.Contains(out, "synthetic-agent") {
+				t.Fatalf("the dump should still show the other headers, got:\n%s", out)
+			}
+			for _, secret := range []string{apiKey, "synthetic-cookie-value"} {
+				if strings.Contains(out, secret) {
+					t.Errorf("the recovery dump leaks %q:\n%s", secret, out)
+				}
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}
